_note: Antariksh (E1) lines: said only when the child SEES the 3D engine (the client reports which renderer is on screen; the server checks the engine renders this level). They replace the Nishana family's lines for the same moment, which name the 2D view's flag. Shapes filled from on-screen facts; noticing the world, never judging the child; no verdict, praise, pressure or economy words (shared/play.ts REACTION_BANNED); never the fire/scan verb (the parent's O-G4 switch changes only the button and the sound).

hinglish: {?goal=place}Dekho, {value} ka nishana asal mein kahan khula.
{?goal=compare}Gate dekho: line par kaun zyada baayein hai?
{?goal=round}{value} beech wale nishaan se kis taraf hai?
en: {?goal=place}Look where the target for {value} really was.
{?goal=compare}Look at the gates: which one sits further left?
hi: {?goal=place}देखो, {value} का निशाना असल में कहाँ खुला।
{?goal=compare}गेट देखो: रेखा पर कौन ज़्यादा बाईं ओर है?
{?goal=round}{value} बीच वाले निशान से किस तरफ़ है?

en: {?why=look_again}Look at the numbers on the gates.

hinglish: {?goal=place}{value} wahin chhupa tha jahan nishana laga.
{?goal=compare}Chhota wala baayein hai, wahi gate khula.
en: {?goal=place}{value} was hiding exactly where you aimed.
{?goal=compare}The smaller one sits left; that gate opened.
hi: {?goal=place}{value} ठीक वहीं छिपा था जहाँ निशाना लगा।
{?goal=compare}छोटा वाला बाईं ओर है, वही गेट खुला।

hinglish: {?landed=yes}{value} line par aa gaya. Ab zyada paas wale gate mein udo.
{?landed=both}Dono mil gaye. Ab chhote wale ke gate mein udo.
en: {?landed=yes}{value} is on the line. Now fly into the nearer gate.
{?landed=both}Both found. Now fly into the smaller one's gate.
hi: {?landed=yes}{value} रेखा पर आ गया। अब ज़्यादा पास वाले गेट में उड़ो।
{?landed=both}दोनों मिल गए। अब छोटे वाले के गेट में उड़ो।
